Buyer reserves the right to enter into a CMC agreement with the Successful Bidder / OEM after expiry of the Warranty period at above mentioned rate and the payment for the CMC charges would be made Quarterly after rendering of the CMC Services of the relevant CMC period. Performance Security of the successful bidder shall be forfeited if it fails to accept the CMC contract when called upon by the buyer. CMC would include cost of All required spare parts (Upload the undertaking). OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Should be supplied with Intel® Core™ i5 processor or higher, 13th Generation or later, or equivalent AMD processor, with a minimum of 6 physical cores and minimum base frequency of 2.5 GHz, compatible with t he supplied equipment acquisition, recording and analysis software. 8. ALARM CONDITIONS 1. The equipment should provide clear indication of impedance/electrode contact status during screening. 2. The equipment should provide indication of operational errors and invalid measurements sup ported by the quoted model. 3. Safety-related faults and relevant automatic protective indications supported by the quoted model should be clearly indicated. 4. The bidder should submit the manufacturer's original list of available alarm/error messages, s afety interlocks and automatic protective/cut-off conditions for the quoted model with the tech nical bid. 9. CONSUMABLES & ACCESSORIES 1. At least 2 sets of stainless-steel electrodes reusable suitable for term infants should be supplied. 2. At least 2 sets of stainless-steel electrodes reusable suitable for pre-term infants should be supplied. 3. Twenty (20) sets of electrode gel protection, with 3 pieces in each set, should be supplied.

4. Twenty (20) bottles of electrode gel, 300 mL each, should be supplied. 5. Compatible insert receivers 50 units with each machine should be supplied. 6. Two hard-copy sets and one soft copy of user, technical and maintenance manuals in English shou ld be supplied. 7. A certificate of calibration, where applicable, and contact details of the manufacturer, supplier and authorized service agent should be supplied. TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. Prices so quoted should be frozen for 10 years including warranty. 2. CAMC for 5 years after warranty. CAMC should cover preventive maintenance, service visits, labour and c overed replacement parts/spares, excluding routine consumables. Items covered under CAMC and warrant y should be clearly enlisted, along with items not covered under CAMC and warranty. 3. Original literature, and not the photocopy, should be supplied with the quotation. Company should certify that the model quoted is the latest and not obsolete, and spares are available for minimum 10 years including warranty. Frozen rate should not be more than the price of the quoted rate on the date of purchase. 4. Rate list of all the accessories/consumables should be provided separately. These rates should be frozen for next 10 years. 5. Provision for providing 1 loaner AABR screener if time taken for repair is more than 14 days. 6. Physical demonstration of the quoted model will be taken to verify the specifications. 7. The supplier/company should install and commission the equipment, perform safety and operatio n checks before handover, and provide hands-on training to designated users. 8. The bidder should submit all applicable certifications, licences and test reports with the technical bid and/or at the time of supply, as required.
